recall.define: Using the coroutine representations, define a suspended frame, continuation, defunctionalized tag, yield boundary, fiber stack, parser commitment, packrat memo entry and exactly-once completion.
recall.distinguish: Distinguish stackless resumable state from a separate fiber stack, callback cancellation intent from quiescent disarm, and parser backtracking from committed failure. Identify the owner of every suspended borrow.
recall.apply: Cancel an async frame after partial progress while a notification is queued, then transfer the parser to a mutable input window. Revise frame lifetime and memo invalidation arguments and construct a stale-resumption counterexample.
